item.title: Why cancer survivorship must protect the heart too
item.description: By Dr Mastura Mohd Sopian On the day cancer treatment ends, many patients expect life to finally return to normal. The scans are clear, the appointments become less frequent, and family members breathe a collective sigh of relief. After months or years of fear and uncertainty, the word “survivor” feels like a finish line. item.title: Healing by design
item.description: By Ooi Ow Wen What is the fundamental difference between treating and healing?
